    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CriteriaMet_Award" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="Task_AwardCertification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">all criteria are met</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CriteriaNotMet" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet" targetRef="End_CriteriaNotMet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Award_IssueDocuments" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueDocuments_End" sourceRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments" targetRef="End_CertificationIssued"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ComplianceAudit"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/compliance-audit">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ComplianceAudit" name="Compliance audit and certification" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Process" name="Process starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ScheduleAudit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScheduleAudit" name="Schedule compliance audit">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ScheduleAudit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Schedule_PreparationSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Begin audit preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Schedule_PreparationSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_PrepareDocumentation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_GatherEvidence</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SelfAssessment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDocumentation" name="Prepare documentation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_PrepareDocumentation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepareDocumentation_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEvidence" name="Gather evidence">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_GatherEvidence</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GatherEvidence_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductSelfAssessment" name="Conduct self-assessment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SelfAssessment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelfAssessment_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Preparation complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepareDocumentation_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GatherEvidence_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelfAssessment_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_ReviewProcesses</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewProcesses" name="Review company processes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_ReviewProcesses</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_IdentifyGaps</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyGaps" name="Identify gaps or issues">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_IdentifyGaps</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IdentifyGaps_Corrections</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeCorrections" name="Make corrections or improvements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IdentifyGaps_Corrections</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Corrections_FinalAudit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductFinalAudit" name="Conduct final audit">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Corrections_FinalAudit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalAudit_CriteriaMet</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwardCertification" name="Award certification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalAudit_CriteriaMet</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Award_IssueDocuments</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments" name="Issue official documents">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Award_IssueDocuments</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IssueDocuments_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CertificationIssued" name="Official documents issued">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IssueDocuments_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ScheduleAudit" sourceRef="Start_Process" targetRef="Task_ScheduleAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Schedule_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Task_ScheduleAudit" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_PrepareDocumentation" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_GatherEvidence" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GatherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SelfAssessment" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ConductSelfAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareDocumentation_Join" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatherEvidence_Join" sourceRef="Task_GatherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfAssessment_Join" sourceRef="Task_ConductSelfAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ReviewProcesses" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_ReviewProcesses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_IdentifyGaps" sourceRef="Task_ReviewProcesses" targetRef="Task_IdentifyGaps"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyGaps_Corrections" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyGaps" targetRef="Task_MakeCorrections"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Corrections_FinalAudit" sourceRef="Task_MakeCorrections" targetRef="Task_ConductFinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalAudit_CriteriaMet" sourceRef="Task_ConductFinalAudit" targetRef="Task_AwardCertification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">criteriaMet</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Award_IssueDocuments" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueDocuments_End" sourceRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments" targetRef="End_CertificationIssued"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description names multiple required activities without specifying their order and states that a later outcome depends on all of them: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them before that outcome.
rules.situation: the description lists several distinct activities that must be completed before a later phase, without specifying an order or dependency among them.

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity together with criteria, optional supporting actions, or a later outcome associated with it: Label the BPMN task with a concise verb-object phrase for the activity itself. Keep associated criteria, alternatives, and subsequent outcomes out of the label unless they define the activity.
rules.situation: the description states an activity together with criteria or a subsequent outcome associated with it

rules.instruction: When the description identifies work performed by a participant as the first step of the process: Model that work as an activity after a start event and before the subsequent activity; do not represent the work itself as the start event.
rules.situation: the description identifies an action performed by a participant as the first step of the process

rules.instruction: When the description states that a concrete action is performed to produce or deliver an outcome before the process reaches its stated terminal outcome: model the concrete work as a task and then use an end event for the terminal outcome
rules.situation: the description states that a concrete action is performed to produce or deliver an outcome before the process reaches its stated terminal outcome

rules.instruction: When the description states that a review is performed and separately identifies findings from that review: Model the review and the identification of findings as distinct BPMN tasks when they are described as separate activities.
rules.situation: the description states that a review is performed and separately identifies findings from that review
